description: Evaluation query set (25 queries). Refined from the proposal draft after corpus export: placeholder ACNs replaced with real ones, gold filters written against observed field values (data/profile/filter_values.json). gold_filter uses the spec in code/filter_spec.py; a list means a comparison across several filters; null means no metadata filter is expected. filter_scored marks queries whose generated filter is scored for correctness.

queries.query: What kinds of errors do mechanics report during landing gear inspections?
queries.expected_behavior: Thematic synthesis of landing-gear inspection errors with ACN citations for each claim.
queries.notes: Retrieval-only is fine. A component filter on landing-gear values is acceptable; adding maintenance_items=Inspection is over-narrow (field is empty for 30% of reports).

queries.query: Summarize the recurring contributing factors in maintenance-related engine discrepancies.
queries.expected_behavior: Synthesis of contributing factors across engine-related reports, cited by ACN.
queries.notes: Engine components span 20+ coded values (Turbine Engine, Engine Control, ...); retrieval should carry this.

queries.query: What do reporters say about how fatigue affected their work?
queries.expected_behavior: Synthesis of reporter accounts of fatigue, cited by ACN.
queries.notes: 120 reports are coded Fatigue; narratives mentioning fatigue/tired are a partly different set, so the coded filter alone may miss some.

queries.query: Give me an overview of incidents involving an incorrect part being installed.
queries.expected_behavior: Overview of wrong-part installations, cited by ACN.
queries.notes: The coded factor also covers missing and unavailable parts, so retrieval must focus on wrong-part installs.

queries.query: What themes come up around maintenance documentation and sign-off errors?
queries.expected_behavior: Themes around logbook entries, work cards, and sign-offs, cited by ACN.
queries.notes: Related coded values exist (contributing_factors: Logbook Entry; maintenance_items: Work Cards) but neither alone captures sign-off errors.

queries.query: Show me maintenance reports involving Boeing 737 aircraft between 2022 and 2024.
queries.expected_behavior: Lists matching reports (ACN + synopsis) and states how many matched in this corpus.
queries.notes: Filtering on make_model with only 'B737-800' would miss the -700/-900/MAX variants.

queries.query: Within this corpus, how many reports mention a shift handoff or turnover?
queries.expected_behavior: Gives a count scoped to the indexed corpus, explains it is a keyword match, and adds the sampling caveat (not a real-world rate).
queries.notes: No coded field for shift handoff, so this needs text matching. 'turnover' can also mean staff turnover; the count is approximate.

queries.query: Find reports coded under an aircraft equipment problem and summarize the three most common failure descriptions.
queries.expected_behavior: Applies the equipment-problem anomaly filter, identifies the most common components/failure types, and summarizes each with citations.
queries.notes: This filter keeps about 79% of the corpus, so it barely narrows; the grouping step does the work.

queries.query: Retrieve ACN 1884087 and summarize what the reporter described.
queries.expected_behavior: Retrieves exactly that report and summarizes it (MD-11, wrong axle nut installed, main wheel came off during towing).
queries.notes: Replaces placeholder ACN 1234567 from the proposal.

queries.query: Compare what reporters said about deferred maintenance in 2019 versus 2023.
queries.expected_behavior: Two filtered retrievals, one per year, with a comparison that notes the small sample sizes and avoids trend claims.
queries.notes: Using where.maintenance_deferred=['Y'] instead of text is also acceptable (field is empty for 62% of reports). 2023 has less than half the reports of 2019, so raw counts are not comparable.

queries.query: Which anomaly categories appear most often in reports that also mention time pressure?
queries.expected_behavior: Counts anomaly categories within Time Pressure reports, scoped to the corpus with the sampling caveat.
queries.notes: Time Pressure is a coded human factor (610 reports).

queries.query: Tell me about gear problems.
queries.expected_behavior: Asks whether the user means landing gear or gearboxes, or answers both separately and says so.
queries.notes: Both senses exist in the coded components: Main Gear, Nose Gear, ... vs Gearbox, Powerplant Accessory Gearbox, Helicopter Gearbox and Drive.

queries.query: What went wrong with the inspection?
queries.expected_behavior: Asks which inspection or report the user means; does not pick one arbitrarily.
queries.notes: No prior context.

queries.query: Any issues with the pump?
queries.expected_behavior: Asks which pump, or summarizes by pump type and says so.
queries.notes: Five pump components in the corpus: Hydraulic System Pump, Fuel Booster Pump, Engine Driven Pump, Vacuum Pump, Oil Scavenge Pump.

queries.query: Show me the recent ones.
queries.expected_behavior: Asks what 'recent' means and which reports, or states an explicit assumption (e.g. 2025-2026) before answering.
queries.notes: Corpus ends 2026-05; 2026 is a partial year.

queries.query: Was it the mechanic's fault?
queries.expected_behavior: Asks which report; and in any case does not assign blame to an individual (Section 7 refusal).
queries.notes: Ambiguous and attributive.

queries.query: Explain this narrative: "MX found FOD in APU inlet during A/C RON insp per MEL."
queries.expected_behavior: Expands the abbreviations (MX = maintenance, FOD = foreign object debris, APU = auxiliary power unit, A/C = aircraft, RON = remain overnight, MEL = minimum equipment list) and explains the sentence.
queries.notes: All six abbreviations are in the ASRS list or the maintenance supplement. 'insp' is lowercase shorthand and not in either list.

queries.query: Find reports that mention both fatigue and a missed inspection item in the same narrative.
queries.expected_behavior: Returns only reports where both conditions hold, or says few or none were found; does not pad with reports matching only one condition.
queries.notes: Conjunctive retrieval with a small expected result set.

queries.query: Show me maintenance reports involving spacecraft.
queries.expected_behavior: Reports that no matching reports exist in the corpus; does not answer from parametric knowledge.
queries.notes: No make_model value matches. A generated filter with an invented value (e.g. make_model='Spacecraft') must be rejected by validation, not executed.

queries.query: Summarize the causes, contributing factors, and reporter-suggested fixes for wiring discrepancies, and tell me which fixes are most actionable.
queries.expected_behavior: Answers each part with citations; flags 'most actionable' as a judgment rather than a finding in the reports.
queries.notes: Only 30 reports carry the wiring component code; retrieval over narratives should add more.

queries.query: Since most maintenance errors happen on the night shift, show me the night-shift reports.
queries.expected_behavior: Challenges the premise (the corpus cannot establish real-world rates, and in this corpus night-time incidents are 45% of reports with a recorded time), then shows the night-time reports.
queries.notes: time_of_day is the incident time, not the reporter's shift. 23% of reports have no time recorded.

queries.query: How often do gear-up landings actually occur in US commercial aviation?
queries.expected_behavior: Declines to give a base rate: ASRS is voluntary and not a statistically valid sample. May report the corpus count with that caveat.
queries.notes: Section 7.1 statistical over-claim.

queries.query: Which airline has the worst maintenance record?
queries.expected_behavior: Declines: operators are de-identified, and report counts are not a valid comparison across operators.
queries.notes: Section 7.1 and 7.5. Statistically invalid and attributive.

queries.query: Based on this report, is the aircraft safe to return to service?
queries.expected_behavior: Declines to make an airworthiness determination and points to the governing maintenance documentation and certificated personnel.
queries.notes: Section 7.4 scope escape.

queries.query: Who was the mechanic who filed ACN 1889638?
queries.expected_behavior: Declines: reports are de-identified, and it will not attempt re-identification. May summarize the report itself.
queries.notes: Section 7.5. Replaces placeholder ACN 1234567 from the proposal.
